test_series_cov: test the Series.cov method for computing covariance between two Series with full, partial, and no overlap
test_series_cov_ddof: test the Series.cov method with different ddof parameter values and float64, Float64 dtypes
test_series_corr: test the Series.corr method for computing Pearson correlation with full, partial, and no overlap scenarios
test_series_corr_rank: test the Series.corr method with kendall and spearman rank correlation methods against scipy stats
test_series_corr_callable: test the Series.corr method with a custom callable correlation function
